subject: Weekend meet-and-greet heads-up
text:
Hey,

Wanted to throw out an invite while it’s still fresh. Our street’s doing a little evening meet-and-greet on the cul-de-sac this Saturday, just snacks, lawn chairs, and people pretending they know each other well. Since we see each other around the office and also on the sidewalk, figured you’d fit right in, especially if you’re after easy company rather than awkward networking. There’ll be chili, lemonade, and that questionable potato salad that everyone always judges.

That said, I have one goofy snag: I already promised to watch the neighbor’s parrot while the family goes to their cousin’s wedding rehearsal. Don’t ask me to explain why I volunteered; I’ll likely pop out near the end, but I might not be there to greet folks or chase off the raccoon that keeps treating our recycling like a treasure chest. So if you come, feel free to grab a chair, say hi, and tell anyone weird you saw me. I’ll be around, mostly behind the grill, likely muttering to myself.

Anyway, no pressure. If you’re free and want to crash, I’ll save you a spot near the shade tree. If not, totally fine—maybe next time we can grab coffee. The kids are bringing a soccer ball, so expect chaos if you like that sort of thing. Bring your own plate if you have one, but honestly just showing up is plenty. If you’d rather meet somewhere quieter, I owe you a pastry from that bakery by the train stop.
